comment: Generated by script/build_freedos_image.py; FreeDOS kit provenance.

reason: The Watcom 386 IntDosCal path saves FS in SI at line 219, but SwitchToInt2fStack overwrites SI with caller SS at line 47; line 233 then restores the wrong FS.

An empty-CD FindFirst trace in r86 observed FS change from 1666h to 00DAh across INT 2F/1206. SHSUCDX returned CF=1/AX=0015h correctly; the kernel wrote the error result through the wrong FS and returned CF=0 with original AX=4E2Bh to FreeCOM.
A fresh QEMU boot independently reproduced the false setup-media detection with the 386 kernel and no SHARE.
The unmodified 86f32 release omits this XCPU>=386 FS/GS wrapper. No kernel patch or startup media guard is applied.

mbr.source: FD14LITE.img bytes 0-439; zero disk metadata; 55AA signature
mbr.planter: Keep bytes 0-439; supply disk identity and partition table.

fat16.planter: Keep bytes 0-2 and 62-511; replace the BPB.

fat32.source: Pinned br_fat32fd_0x52.h first 430 array bytes at offset 0x52, EB5890 jump and zero BPB; FSInfo tail excluded.
fat32.planter: Keep bytes 0-2 and 90-511; replace BPB including FAT32 ID.

sources: Every installed release-package SOURCE member is preserved under its source_copy_prefix. sources/ke2046s.zip contains the kernel source; sources/boot holds the bootstrap source archive and pinned data header. Original package documentation and license files remain in base.

startup.default: Playing profile: HIMEMX; DOS=HIGH,NOUMB; VERSION=7.10; FILES=30; BUFFERS=10; LASTDRIVE=E. No mouse, CD-ROM or power-management TSR autoload.
startup.playing_menu: FreeDOS profile only: default 1 (HIMEMX), 2-second delay; optional 2 (JEMMEX with EMS and UMB), 3 (switchable HIMEMX, DOS=LOW and SHARE; DOS prompt).
startup.win98_setup: HIMEMX /METHOD:FAST; DOS=LOW,NOUMB for DOSX. SETUP /IS /IQ /NM skips the false minimum-hardware failure under FreeDOS; /NM bypasses CPU, memory and FPU checks (Microsoft KB189670).
startup.ems_firmware_limit: The optional CA00-D9FF frame is for the bundled SeaBIOS with stdvga or handheld VGA ROM layouts. S=DA00-EFFF scans writable shadow RAM outside detected ROMs for UMBs. JEMMEX's non-16KiB-aligned frame warning remains visible.
startup.on_demand: MOUSE.BAT loads CTMOUSE for PS/2. CDROM.BAT loads UDVD2 /H and SHSUCDX as D:; setup calls it only when installation is needed. SHARE.BAT loads the pinned SHARE.COM and forwards its options.

share_compatibility: FreeDOS 1.4 SHARE lacks INT 2F/10A6 required by kernel 2046 for delete/rename.
The pinned ECM source implements INT 2F/10A6. Its shipped executable uses a 64-byte private stack for a verified 92-byte ordinary handler path.
The builder decodes only that pinned executable, increases the reserve to 512 bytes with one byte change, and verifies the full result hash.
The original source/archive, minimal source patch and notices are retained. No compiler or external decompressor is downloaded or run.
